_comment: Stage 7 canonical store for History (sample). Built from the REAL 2023 LC History Higher Level paper, extracted live from examinations.ie on 2026-06-06 via the verified form-discovery + pdf.js text pass. Question text is verbatim; marks are from the paper. `model` is empty pending the Stage 6 marking-scheme (M99) pairing — exactly as the existing biology entries in exam-questions-db.js currently sit. Topic tags (Stage 5) were trivial here because History papers label every question by topic on the page.
